title: Programa Crédito Beca 2027

compensation.value: Credit of up to USD 50,000; up to 65% can become a scholarship if the beneficiary graduates and returns to Colombia

about: COLFUTURO's 2027 Crédito Beca call funds Colombians with an undergraduate degree for postgraduate study abroad with credit of up to USD 50,000, up to 65% convertible into a scholarship on graduating and returning. Applications run 4 January to 4 March 2027.
requirements: Hold an undergraduate degree (título de pregrado)
Present the programme of interest and a written essay
If selected, certify proficiency in a second language when formalising the credit
card_alt: Card for Programa Crédito Beca 2027 from COLFUTURO in Colombia, deadline 4 Mar 2027. The photo shows the Gothic-style Las Lajas Sanctuary in Nariño, Colombia, built on an arched stone bridge across a green canyon.
